failure_reason: requested the last 1 conversation images, but only 0 were available
negative_en: broken facial features, plastic-looking skin, illustration look, cartoon style, unrealistic hands, body distortion, fake-looking background, excessive HDR, over-processed retouching
prompt_en: Create a photorealistic editorial documentary photograph of the adult woman from the attached reference image as the lead paper conservator during a public maritime-museum demonstration. Use the attached reference only for her facial appearance, hair, and visible identity. At a waist-high archival table, harmless dropped cards remain visible across the tabletop and clean museum floor after a sleeve bump scatters catalog cards and two color strips. Capture the embarrassment repair display—an embarrassment-repair display in the restitution phase: her head remains slightly dipped from a brief gaze break while her eyes return to the adult colleague beside her; she wears a small closed-lip smile, the back of two fingers briefly touching one cheek. In the same instant, her gaze briefly breaks then starts to return, with a small closed smile and a brief cheek touch. With her free hand she re-stacks the scattered acid-free catalog cards into their labeled archival tray in correct order; her hands actively gather and reorder the items into the labeled archival tray. Beside her, the adult peer helps with the repair by returning the last card with an accepting nod. Knee-up, table-height documentary framing keeps face, hands, cards, tray, and peer legible. Mixed cool skylight and warm task light reveal natural skin, believable hand contact, and paper fibers.
